'''Marrt''' was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[182nd Legion]]. During the first years of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Marrt and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]&mdash;[[Chatter]], [[Recon]], and [[Knuckles (182nd Legion)|Knuckles]]&mdash;were sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belgaroth]] on a [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] [[Mission to Belgaroth|mission]] to check a local Republic [[Czerka factory|factory]] suspected of selling arms to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic's enemy in the war. The factory was operated by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]], a corporation specializing in weaponry. Once on Belgaroth, Marrt discovered that the head of the facility, [[Tarin (Human)|Tarin]], was secretly dealing with representative [[Reep Tonith]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], which was connected to the Confederacy.

During the course of the mission, the three other men in Marrt's squad were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[droidbreaker]], a creature indigenous to Belgaroth. The [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], however, managed to take Tarin into custody, obtained valuable evidence from the facility, and then burned it to the ground. [[Standard week/Legends|Weeks]] later, while he was recovering on [[Sacorria]] from the injuries he had sustained on Belgaroth, Marrt requested a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] representative to come visit him in his [[Sacorria clone medical and rehabilitation facility|medical facility]]. When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived at the facility, Marrt handed them the evidence that he had extracted from the Czerka factory, an act that helped Fisto expose two [[Senator/Legends|senators]] who had been profiting from deals with the Confederacy.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The battle raged for hours. Before the s-sun had risen, the skies of Belgaroth were illuminated by flames. Reep Tonith fled in his shuttle, but I managed to shackle Tarin&hellip;before my w-wounds finally brought me down. The fight cost me m-my legs&hellip;but it was worth it.|Marrt|<ref name="Tale" />}}
Marrt was the nickname<ref name="Tale" /> of one of many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] produced from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] and bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> By the time of the [[22 BBY/Legends|first]] [[21 BBY/Legends|two]] years of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="A Trooper's Tale date">In the framing story for ''[[A Trooper's Tale]]'', [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] appears in her original costume from ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', indicating that the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] takes place prior to the episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," in which she receives a new outfit to signify the passage of [[Time/Legends|time]] (per {{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode310.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides}}). "Heroes on Both Sides" can be dated to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] since it occurs between two episodes, "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]]" and "[[Pursuit of Peace]]," that are also placed in 21 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] by two other sources: {{FactFile2014|62|21 BBY 17-18|Defence of Kamino}} and {{FactFile2014|7|KAT 1-2|King Katuunko}}, respectively. Therefore, ''A Trooper's Tale'' must take place after the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], but no later than 21 BBY, the date of "Heroes on Both Sides."</ref> Marrt served as a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] with the [[182nd Legion]], as the war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] raged throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], rumors spread that a Republic-affiliated [[Czerka factory|factory]] run by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka corporation]] on the planet [[Belgaroth]] was secretly trading with the Confederacy. Marrt, along with a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]&mdash;[[Chatter]], [[Recon]], and [[Knuckles (182nd Legion)|Knuckles]]&mdash;was sent to Belgaroth to investigate those claims. After landing on the planet by [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] and trekking to the factory, the four clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] separated; while Marrt proceeded to check the factory, the rest of the squad remained in hiding nearby.<ref name="Tale" />

[[File:Marrt_grenades.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Marrt inspects the cargo of FEX-M3 grenades.]]
Inside the Czerka factory, Marrt witnessed [[Tarin (Human)|Tarin]], the head of the facility, talking to [[Reep Tonith]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], an organization with ties to the Confederacy. The two were discussing a shipment of [[FEX-M3 nerve gas grenade]]s&mdash;which had been banned by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] earlier&mdash;to Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. Tarin had failed to produce the requested amount of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] and asked Tonith to give him more time, to which the latter grudgingly agreed. Marrt obtained one of the grenades as evidence and attempted to slip back to his men undetected but was spotted by a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] from Tonith's escort. As the rest of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] opened fire, Marrt ordered a tactical retreat, and the four clone troopers fell back to a foggy swamp.<ref name="Tale" />

Chatter tried to contact Republic headquarters, but the fog affected their [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], and they were unable to do so. To make matters worse, a sudden screech sounded over the swamp and frightened Knuckles, who suspected that more battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had found them. However, Recon, a skilled scout, realized that the sound was emitted by something big that was approaching their way&mdash;indeed, a native creature known as a [[droidbreaker]] suddenly emerged from the fog and charged at Recon. Marrt shouted at the trooper, telling him to move away, but Recon, unable to react in time, was hit by the droidbreaker and hurled into a [[Tree/Legends|tree]], [[Death/Legends|dying]] upon impact. As the creature chewed on Recon's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], Chatter frantically fired his own weapon at the creature. He was unable to hit the droidbreaker because of the fog, and Marrt ordered him to cease fire.<ref name="Tale" />

The three troopers realized that they were standing in the creature's natural habitat and needed to get out of the swamp. Before they could come up with a plan, the droidbreaker struck again and killed Chatter. In response, Knuckles attacked the creature with his bare hands, but he was unable to inflict any damage to it and told Marrt to hide while he distracted the beast. Knuckles was killed as well, though his distraction gave Marrt precious time to formulate a plan to defeat the droidbreaker. Clenching the stolen nerve grenade in his [[Limb/Legends|hands]], Marrt scaled a tree, taking position high above the ground on a branch. When the beast prepared to attack him, Marrt threw the grenade at it, and the droidbreaker caught the grenade in its mouth. Marrt then opened fire with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], detonating the grenade and killing the creature instantly.<ref name="Tale" />

Marrt buried his fallen squadmates under the droidbreaker's severed head and swore a battle oath: to burn the shipment of nerve grenades before it could be sent off-planet. Marrt single-handedly assaulted the Czerka factory and fought for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] against Tonith's battle droids, receiving major injuries to his legs during the fight. In the end, he destroyed the droids, shackled Tarin, and burned the facility to the ground, although Tonith escaped in his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Additionally, fearing that Tarin might not reveal the identity of his superiors, Marrt had obtained Czerka's data records before he set fire to the factory. As he was evacuated from Belgaroth, Marrt kept the data records with him, hoping to deliver them to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] personally.<ref name="Tale" />

[[File:Marrt_in_medical_facility.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Marrt recovering on Sacorria]]
Marrt was [[Transport/Legends|transported]] to the [[Sacorria clone medical and rehabilitation facility|clone medical and rehabilitation facility]] on the planet [[Sacorria]] to undergo treatment for his injuries. Meanwhile, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] interrogated Tarin, but the man refused to tell anything to his captors. Three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, Marrt contacted the Jedi Order and requested that [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] send a Jedi to Sacorria. Yoda assigned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to address the clone's request, and the two soon arrived at the medical facility. Marrt told Fisto the story of his mission to Belgaroth and presented him with the extracted data records. Checking them, Fisto discovered that two influential [[Senator/Legends|senators]] were responsible for selling arms to the enemy. Fisto and Tano promised to deal with the traitors and commended Marrt on his bravery. They then left Sacorria and let the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] continue his recovery.<ref name="Tale" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Brave scout, you ''honour'' the Republic with your heroism.|Kit Fisto, to Marrt|<ref name="Tale" />}}
Marrt was deeply affected by the loss of his squad on Belgaroth and swore to carry out the mission alone after their deaths. He believed that Knuckles' attempt to distract the droidbreaker was brave and thought that it was only thanks to that distraction that he was able to conquer the beast. Marrt was able to complete his mission despite the injuries he had sustained, and he was farsighted enough to extract the data records from the facility before destroying it. Despite being severely injured and weakened during his meeting with the Jedi, Marrt kept a positive attitude, referring to his mission as a "little tale" and behaving sarcastically toward his [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B]] [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]]. Fisto considered Marrt's actions on Belgaroth brave and reminded Tano&mdash;who had been reluctant to go to Sacorria in the belief that a meeting with some wounded clone was a waste of time&mdash;that even the actions of a single soldier could be very important.<ref name="Tale" /> Like his [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]], Jango Fett, Marrt stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Databank" /> He had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]<ref name="Tale" /> and blue<ref name="Eye color" /> [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Tale" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In issue #6.8, Ahsoka learns a valuable lesson in clone courage when she and Kit Fisto hear the tale of a badly wounded soldier. Are you brave enough to accompany trooper Marrt back to the planet where his entire squadron was wiped out?|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.8'' announcement on [[StarWars.com]]|<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/clonewars_ukcomic_68/index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' UK Comic #6.8}}</ref>}}
Marrt appeared in ''[[A Trooper's Tale]]'', a short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] strip published in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.8|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic'' 6.8]] in [[May]] of [[2010]]. The framing story is set on Sacorria, and Marrt serves as the narrator for the main storyline that depicts the mission on Belgaroth. ''A Trooper's Tale'' was written by [[Robin Etherington]] and illustrated by [[Andres Ponce]].<ref name="Tale" />
